item.title: Equestrian Terms: The Complete Glossary
item.description: From your first rising trot to the finer points of collection in Grand Prix dressage, the language of equestrianism is rich, precise, and deeply rewarding to learn. This complete glossary covers every equestrian term you are likely to encounter, whatever your discipline or level.

item.title: Girl Horse Names: 200+ Ideas
item.description: <Choosing the right girl horse name is one of the most personal decisions a horse owner makes. This guide covers 200+ names across every style, with the meaning and story behind each.>

item.title: What Does "Equestrian" Actually Mean?
item.description: "Equestrian" runs far deeper than a riding style or a fashion aesthetic — it's a word with 2,000 years of history that still shapes how we live, compete, and connect with horses today. Here's everything it truly means.
